title: Runtime semantic attractor diagnostics for user-visible failures
description: Convert repeated user-visible failures into concept/proximity diagnostics: user intent, dispatch lifecycle, terminal state, semantic outcome, finality, visual evidence, and user correction must be combined before choosing heavy reasoning or external retry.
resume_hint: P0.21 implements the first narrow attractor: explicit external ChatGPT consultation + dispatch success + outcome=reused_context + is_final=false means no new ChatGPT answer was captured and the UI must not keep processing. Operational status questions now answer from runtime telemetry instead of heavy local inference.
next_action: Generalize the P0.21 status/reuse rule into a shared metacognitive scoring helper consumed by ControlCenterViewModel and OSES: classify proximity_to_solution, missing_evidence, and next_best_action from existing metadata without creating another brain.

source_evidence.observed_pattern: external_consultation dispatch_terminal=success followed by interaction_outcome outcome=reused_context is_final=false
source_evidence.user_visible_symptom: UI showed processing / user perceived no ChatGPT consultation

control_center_viewmodel: explicit external consultations pass force_new_external_consultation to ToolTeachService
tool_teach_service: force_new_external_consultation disables reuse_guard_active and reused pattern actions only for consultation_scope=external_assistant

universal_algorithm_target.attractor_rule: If concepts indicate the technical route completed but semantic answer is missing, report the gap and next required evidence instead of continuing heavy inference.
universal_algorithm_target.future_metric: proximity_to_solution_score = evidence_present / evidence_required, with blockers labeled as missing_evidence rather than failure noise.

unresolved: Move the attractor scoring out of UI helper methods into a shared read-only metacognition utility or existing OSES path without creating a new orchestrator.
Add OSES finding when repeated reused_context non-final or operational-status followups occur.
Live Windows proof after updating runtime to P0.21.
